content.lead: After this unit you will be able to:
items: greet people formally and informally at different times of day and say goodbye;
say your name, age and nationality, and where you come from;
ask other people the same questions, and choose du or Sie to suit the situation;
spell your name in German and count to 100;
use sein and the present tense of regular verbs such as kommen, wohnen and heißen.
